text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up: we've published a small set of handbook edits around remote work expectations and mandatory compliance training. link: https://docs.redwood.com/handbook/remote-work :sparkles:
Jonas (Eng Manager): thanks — are the changes major? do managers need to re-sign off with their teams?
Maya (People Ops): mostly clarifications on async meeting etiquette, timezone overlap guidance, and an explicit removal of the ‘72-hour response’ line that was causing confusion. no manager sign-off required, but please share in your team channels by EOD Mon. :calendar:
Priya (HRIS): HR-Bot just assigned the refresher course "Data Handling & Confidentiality (2024)" to all employees. due date set to 2024-05-10. LMS link in the assignment.
Jonas (Eng Manager): can we get a completion export per team? need to follow up during 1:1s.
Priya (HRIS): yes — i'll add a csv export to the tracking sheet and give managers view-only access. tracker: https://spreadsheets.google.com/remote-policy-compliance-tracker
Elena (People Ops): also adding a column for accommodation requests so folks can flag if they need extra time or alternative formats.
Sam (Legal): quick note — the wording on section 4.2 (data retention) was updated after our review. it's intentionally narrower to avoid overprescribing retention windows. ping me if you see anything that looks like a rollback of legal protections.
Maya (People Ops): action items: 1) managers post summary in team channel (by Mon EOD), 2) managers run CSV report and flag any team members not enrolled by 2024-05-03, 3) People Ops will follow up with non-compliant after the deadline. I'll paste a short template message below you can copy.
Jonas (Eng Manager): copying the template would be super helpful.
Maya (People Ops): Template:
"Hey team — small update to the remote work section of the handbook. Please review the changes and complete the mandatory refresher course by 2024-05-10. If you need accommodations, reply here or submit via the tracker. Thanks!"
Jonas (Eng Manager): posted in #eng. :thumbsup:
Priya (HRIS): FYI — i'll run a report on 2024-05-03 and escalate to managers for any outstanding completions.
Elena (People Ops): i'll run a quick pulse check 2 weeks after deadline to surface any systemic blockers (LMS issues, unclear instructions).
HR-Bot: New assignment: "Data Handling & Confidentiality (2024)" assigned to 150 users; notifications sent. Due: 2024-05-10.
Sam (Legal): thanks everyone. one more ask — if any manager plans to make role-specific exceptions, please loop legal and people ops first.
Jonas (Eng Manager): noted. if someone needs extra time for caregiving reasons i'll escalate.
Maya (People Ops): perfect. i'll update the tracker with a column for "exceptions approved" and add a short SOP for managers. will ping again when that's live.
Elena (People Ops): live update: tracker now shared with all managers (view-only) and people ops (edit). link above.
Jonas (Eng Manager): thanks — closing loop on my side.
Maya (People Ops): closing here — feel free to DM if anything urgent. :pray:
